application_feature_contract.source_support: Paper Table1 explicitly contains Ret_D1, Ret_W1, STD_W1. Select exactly these three direct price descriptors; formulas below are frozen APPLICATION conventions, not a claim that unpublished source feature construction has been reproduced.
application_feature_contract.decision_time: Session t regular exchange close after completed official daily bar is available. No after-close correction first published later may enter the historical prefix.
application_feature_contract.inputs: Split/corporate-action and distribution-correct daily total-return r_i,s=(close_value_i,s + ex-date economic distribution entitlement)/previous_close_value_i,s-1 - 1, using only actions effective and visible by s. Payable-date cash remains separate. Accepted permanent-security episode and action chain required; never retroactively erase a terminal holding or use a currently adjusted series with unknown historical provenance.
application_feature_contract.eligibility: Historical membership U_t frozen from then-visible accepted security episodes and prior-month-end ranking. SOURCE uses previous-month market cap; APPLICATION proposed ranking uses mean raw close*volume over last20 completed sessions ending previous month end, top500, ties stable permanent-security ID. This ADV rule is an explicit price-only adaptation, not market cap or source replication. Require20 observed prior sessions and five valid feature returns at decision. No full-year medians, future survival/completeness or current constituents. Exact dated U_t packet remains unaccepted; uncertain identity retained in coverage/exclusion ledger.
application_feature_contract.cross_section: Within U_t, remove unobservable feature rows using information at t only. Feature rank z=(midrank-0.5)/N - 0.5 in [-0.5,0.5], average rank for ties. Context m_j,t is raw-feature cross-sectional median before rank, repeated on all rows. Input X_i,t=[z_D1,z_W1,z_STD,m_D1,m_W1,m_STD,rf_t] has7 columns.
application_feature_contract.normalization: Rank columns unchanged. Standardize each of the3 median context series using mean and population std fitted on the current training partition only and frozen through its next validation/evaluation fold; std<=1e-12 -> zero centered context. rf_t is the latest published daily risk-free rate available at cutoff, same units as return; normalization fitted on training only. No validation/full-sample fit or cross-time backward-fill.
application_feature_contract.missing: No invented fundamentals or median fill of missing price returns. Exclude missing/stale5-return feature rows at signal time and record reason/coverage; never drop their already-held positions from accounting. Missing rf publication -> retain last actually published rate up to5 sessions; beyond5 -> no new target/no orders. N<=K or <30 mature residual observations -> same no-new-target fallback for paired K streams, record joint coverage; K comparisons additionally common-coverage diagnostic. Do not replace an existing position with zero solely due missing mark.
application_feature_contract.information_difference: Retain3 of source39 characteristics. Omit36 including monthly/long momentum, all accounting/value/investment/profitability/intangible features, volume/size/spread/residual-variance/beta. Three medians+Rf give7 versus source39+39medians+Rf=79. The daily/weekly formulas do not stand in for r2_1/r12_2/r12_7/r36_13/ST_Rev. SOURCE retains original79 definitions/LOCF-then-cross-sectional-median behavior conditional on exact original packet.

application_execution_contract.timezone: America/New_York exchange calendar incl DST/holidays; regular exchange sessions, not UTC calendar days
application_execution_contract.decision: At completed session t close, use feature packet with cutoff t close and only labels matured by then. Calculate attention A_t, P_t=I-A_t.T@(A_t@A_t.T+ridge*I)^(-1)@A_t and policy u_t from30 mature residual returns. Set a_t=P_t.T@u_t; w_t=a_t/sum(abs(a_t)); zero/nonfinite denominator -> no new target. All paired models use identical chronology and asset normalization.
application_execution_contract.projection: P_t and w_t fixed from close t through order release at09:45 of t+1. The new holdings generated from this target are held until next scheduled rebalance09:45 of t+2; never value that horizon with P_t+1 or normalize residual u instead of asset a. Corporate actions transform holdings/entitlements mechanically, not a new model decision.
application_execution_contract.entry: Release at09:45:00 of t+1. First eligible historical NBBO at/after09:45:00 and no later09:45:05, positive noncrossed bid/ask, observed timestamp and source bound. No open/close substitution. Modeled purchases at ask, sales at bid plus20bp executed-notional charge;40bp is stress, source5bp separate. Historical quote supports an execution model only, never proof of actual fill or certified size.
application_execution_contract.exit: Next regular session t+2 at the same09:45 release/5second eligible quote rule, with bid for sale/ask for cover. Rebalance into w_t+1, calculate net orders against the drifted actual holdings; do not liquidate/rebuy common inventory just to manufacture separate daily round trips.
application_execution_contract.label: For each eligible asset, target gross total return from entry midquote(t+1) to exit midquote(t+2), including any ex-date entitlement over the interval and split/terminal consideration. This gross mid-mid label is a model learning input, not realized account return; asset holdings/cash net execution ledger gives modeled account P&L. Label becomes available only after actual exit quote/terminal observation is visible, never at t+1 close. Training as of close T can use decision rows t only when both endpoints and economic action data were visible by T. Usually t<=T-2. No forward-fill of missing exit labels.
application_execution_contract.residual_history: At decision t, use the last30 mature executable-horizon residual observations e_v=P_v R_(v+1:09:45 -> v+2:09:45), each with its own historically causal P_v and input prefix. Latest ordinary v=t-2. Training recomputation uses trainable parameters with the same historical input/label mask; evaluation never uses the next P to price an old position. SOURCE uses its original30 past daily close residual observations separately.
application_execution_contract.cash_costs: At each modeled fill timestamp debit/credit actual integer shares and cash; fees/20bp charged immediately on absolute executed notional, spread already in bid/ask and not duplicated. Integer target uses pretrade marked NAV and whole-share rounding toward zero, orders constrained by actual available settled cash, restricted short proceeds/margin and accepted borrowing rules; scale down before trade if needed, do not assume sale proceeds/short credit are freely spendable. T+1 settlements explicit. Accrue borrow on actual short shares over calendar time at accepted then-visible rate, financing on actual debit balance; missing borrow/financing inputs blocks short account evaluation. Ex-date entitlement is receivable asset, payable date transfers it to cash, no automatic dividend reinvestment. Cash yields0 unless independently specified BIL control. Current20k is initial capital, not daily reset.
application_execution_contract.no_fill: No valid entry quote or unverified capacity/borrow -> no new order in that name, retain previous holdings/cash and record unexecuted amount; deterministic next scheduled decision only, no opportunistic retry. Missing exit quote never implies free liquidation or removal: retain position, record unpriced exposure, executable NAV/return N/A until valid mark/terminal resolution. Feature disappearance does not erase an old position. Model gross diagnostics may use common complete observed labels only with explicit coverage, never relabel that as a complete tradable account.
application_execution_contract.source_difference: SOURCE is original close-to-close gross1 stock weights with5bp turnover+1bp daily short. APPLICATION is the explicit next0945-to-next0945 net-funded account and matched learning return above; its different information/clock cannot reproduce Table2 by definition.

joint.objective: minimize -Sharpe(net asset-space portfolio return excess matched rf) -100*mean_i[1-Var(e_i)/Var(R_i)]
joint.updates: 30 chronological full passes updating Q,W,LongConv together. Daily chronological microbatches accumulate exact whole-training-epoch differentiable moments/turnover, one optimizer update after each whole epoch; no shuffle, early-stop or checkpoint selection; final epoch29. This fixed full-epoch update convention is APPLICATION adaptation, not an inferred source batch schedule. Gradient checkpointing/recomputation may preserve math but exact implementation/resource admission required.
joint.optimizer: AdamW lr0.003; LongConv decay0.05, Q/W decay0; betas0.9/0.999 eps1e-8, no scheduler/clipping. Not claimed source-exact unspecified optimizer grouping.
joint.count: one pipeline fit,30 optimizer updates touching both parameter groups

two_step.factor_objective: minimize -mean_i[1-Var(P_v R_v)_i/Var(R_v)_i] over training matured horizon observations, using population variances, identical causal X/P construction and valid mask. Zero-variance assets excluded by training-only rule and coverage recorded. No net-return term, no policy gradient into factor model.
two_step.factor_stage: Q/W same seed and initialization as JOINT; AdamW lr0.003 weight_decay0, betas0.9/0.999 eps1e-8;30 full training passes, one full-epoch update each. Freeze final factor tensors after epoch29; save/hash their native state.
two_step.policy_stage: Recompute residual history using frozen factor tensors and all same causal dates. Initialize same LongConv policy seed/tensors as JOINT, optimize negative net Sharpe only for30 passes/full-epoch updates, AdamW same LongConv settings; no gradients/update to factor tensors, final epoch29. No joint finetuning afterwards.
two_step.count: one two-stage pipeline,2 fitted model stages,60 optimizer updates.30epochs perstage does not hide doubled exposure; update/compute imbalance vs JOINT reported, no claim of equal compute.

LongConv policy then trained rolling8calendar-years with30fullpasses/updates as above;252 is factor lookback, not replacement of8year policy history.
